"""Own coherent two-column trusted fault; no candidate guard changes."""
import copy
import json
import os
import hashlib
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
import psycopg
import pytest

from agent_guard.authorization.evidence_store import EvidenceError
from agent_guard.contracts.encoding import canonical_json_bytes, load_strict_json
from agent_guard.contracts.execution import ExecutionError
from agent_guard.contracts.ledger import LedgerError
from agent_guard.evidence.receipt import verify_receipt_bundle
from agent_guard.execution.receipt_publication import evidence_bundle
from agent_guard.execution.receipt_projection import project_receipt
from tests.fixtures.gateway import query_bundle
from tests.fixtures.receipts import CorruptRow, full_state, staged_only, publication_only
from tests.integration.test_gateway_receipt_query import app, query_http
from tests.integration.test_receipt_publication import final_env


def test_new_coherent_quote_result_wrong_arithmetic_must_not_publish(
    ledger, dsn, downstream_dsn
):
    env, op, key, verifier, publisher = final_env(dsn, downstream_dsn)
    baseline = full_state(dsn, downstream_dsn)
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as conn:
        quote_raw = bytes(conn.execute("SELECT quote_snapshot FROM ag_operations WHERE operation_id=%s", (op,)).fetchone()[0])
        result_raw = bytes(conn.execute("SELECT result_bytes FROM ag_receipt_outbox WHERE operation_id=%s", (op,)).fetchone()[0])
    quote = load_strict_json(quote_raw)
    result = load_strict_json(result_raw)
    assert quote["items"] == result["items"] and quote["total_fen"] == result["total_fen"]
    bad_quote, bad_result = copy.deepcopy(quote), copy.deepcopy(result)
    bad_quote["items"][0]["unit_price_fen"] += 1
    bad_result["items"][0]["unit_price_fen"] += 1
    assert sum(x["quantity"]*x["unit_price_fen"] for x in bad_quote["items"]) != quote["total_fen"]
    # Normal production protection is observed first, without bypassing guards.
    with pytest.raises(psycopg.Error):
        with psycopg.connect(dsn) as conn:
            conn.execute("UPDATE ag_operations SET quote_snapshot=%s WHERE operation_id=%s", (canonical_json_bytes(bad_quote), op))
    assert full_state(dsn, downstream_dsn) == baseline
    observed = {"classification":"OWNED_PRIVILEGED_COHERENT_TRUSTED_ROW_FAULT_NOT_EXTERNAL_SQL_BYPASS", "ordinary_update_refused":True, "first_evidence_params_totals_and_ds_rows_unchanged":True, "quote_result_unit_price_both_incremented":True, "arithmetic_wrong":True}
    snapshots = Path(os.environ["A23_RECEIPT_EVIDENCE"])
    def save_snapshot(name, state):
        def encode(v):
            if isinstance(v, bytes): return {"raw_bytes_hex":v.hex()}
            if isinstance(v, datetime): return v.isoformat()
            return str(v)
        raw = json.dumps(state, default=encode, indent=2).encode()
        path = snapshots/(name+".private.json");path.write_bytes(raw);path.chmod(0o600)
        return {"path":str(path),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
    observed["baseline_full_state"] = save_snapshot("baseline",baseline)
    application = app(env, dsn, verifier)
    current = query_bundle(env, op)
    try:
        with CorruptRow(dsn, "ag_operations", {"operation_id":op}, {"quote_snapshot":canonical_json_bytes(bad_quote)}), CorruptRow(dsn, "ag_receipt_outbox", {"operation_id":op}, {"result_bytes":canonical_json_bytes(bad_result), "receipt_status":"PENDING", "receipt_jws":None, "signed_at":None}):
            faulty = full_state(dsn, downstream_dsn)
            observed["damaged_before_publish_full_state"] = save_snapshot("damaged-before-publish",faulty)
            try:
                publication = publisher.publish(op)
            except (EvidenceError, ExecutionError, LedgerError, ValueError) as exc:
                observed["publisher_refused"] = True
                observed["publisher_exception_type"] = type(exc).__name__
                assert full_state(dsn, downstream_dsn) == faulty
            else:
                published = full_state(dsn, downstream_dsn)
                publication_only(faulty, published)
                observed["damaged_after_publish_full_state"] = save_snapshot("damaged-after-publish",published)
                observed["only_publication3_changed_all_other_ag_and_ds_unchanged"] = True
                observed["publisher_refused"] = False
                observed["publication_status"] = publication.receipt_status
                with psycopg.connect(dsn) as conn:
                    verified = verify_receipt_bundle(evidence_bundle(project_receipt(conn, op), publication.receipt_jws), trust=verifier._trust_tx(conn, op))
                observed["independent_sdk_accepts_corrupt_material"] = verified.operation_id == op
                before_query = full_state(dsn, downstream_dsn)
                status, response, _ = query_http(application, dsn, current)
                observed["current_query_http_status"] = status
                observed["current_query_code"] = response.get("error", {}).get("code")
                assert status == 503
                staged_only(before_query, full_state(dsn, downstream_dsn), proof_jti=current.query.proof_jti)
            Path(os.environ["A23_RECEIPT_EVIDENCE"], "coherent-quote-result-fault.json").write_text(json.dumps(observed, indent=2)+"\n")
        before_repair = full_state(dsn, downstream_dsn)
        repaired = publisher.publish(op)
        assert repaired.receipt_status == "READY"
        publication_only(before_repair, full_state(dsn, downstream_dsn))
        status, response, _ = query_http(application, dsn, current)
        assert status == 200 and response["receipt_jws"] == repaired.receipt_jws
        assert query_http(application, dsn, current)[0] == 409
        observed["trusted_material_restoration_publish_ready"] = True
        observed["same_proof_after_restoring_original_quote_result_http"] = 200
        observed["replay_after_repair_http"] = 409
        snapshots.joinpath("coherent-quote-result-fault-v2.json").write_text(json.dumps(observed,indent=2)+"\n")
        assert observed["publisher_refused"], "A23-05 malformed original quote arithmetic was signed and committed READY"
    finally:
        application._executor.shutdown()
